module: "Fill" layer type of the Dynamic Decals tool: fills the entire vehicle with a solid color, useful as the base of a design. Provides the "Add Fill Layer" window (color palette + color, OK calls api.addFillLayer then adds the color to the history), the toolbar button (order 10), the inspector GUI of the fill type and the documentation page.
notes: colorPaletteMapId: 0 = the layer's own color (fill_color); 1 = vehicle color (vehicleObj.color); 2 = colorPalette0; 3 = colorPalette1. For values other than 0 the color field is disabled and the preview shows the vehicle's palette color.
The code reads getPlayerVehicle(0) without checking that it is not nil when a palette is chosen.
The blend mode setting of the fill layer is commented out ("heavily WIP").

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets the related modules, registers the add window (360x140), the drawing of this window, the inspector GUI of the fill type, the "fill" toolbar item and the documentation page.
